react_result.final_narrative_text: Cross-paradigm pathway analysis of nine significantly altered metabolites revealed convergent perturbation of glutathione-dependent detoxification and the trans-sulfuration/one-carbon network. RaMP multi-database ORA identified the top-scoring pathway as REACT:R-HSA-1430728 'Metabolism' (FDR 6.92e-05, fold enrichment 35.8) with four input compounds — pantothenic acid (CHEBI:7916), coumarin (CHEBI:28794), glutathione (CHEBI:16856), and O-phospho-L-serine (CHEBI:15811) — as canonical members of this broad metabolic map. Within this signal, a tightly specialised winner emerged: WP:WP2525 'Trans-sulfuration, one-carbon metabolism and related pathways' (FDR 3.58e-04, fold enrichment 450.3) was enriched exclusively through glutathione and O-phospho-L-serine, reflecting the cystathionine-beta-synthase/cystathionine-gamma-lyase axis that links serine-dependent one-carbon units to homocysteine thiolysis and glutathione biosynthesis. The m/z-network method Mummichog independently returned 'Glycine, serine, alanine and threonine metabolism' as its top hit (p=0.0066) with perfect 4-of-4 overlap for the same two driver metabolites — glutathione and O-phospho-L-serine — confirming the serine-glycine interconnection from an empirical-compound network perspective. CoA biosynthesis from pantothenic acid appeared as rank-7 in Mummichog (p=0.052) and was the sole KEGG hit in MetaboAnalystR PSEA (hsa00770, p=0.073), aligning with the water-soluble-vitamin metabolic cluster in RaMP (REACT:R-HSA-196849, FDR 0.00144). Coumarin consistently surfaced in xenobiotic and phase-I oxidation contexts (REACT:R-HSA-211859 'Biological oxidations', FDR 0.00365). The benzo[a]pyrene diol epoxide and N-hydroxy-4-aminobiphenyl, both genotoxic PAH/N-arylamine metabolites, did not individually achieve enrichment significance in any single pathway due to the limited 9-compound input set — their biological threat is structural rather than metabolic-canonical, and they likely act as exogenous triggers that amplify the glutathione-depletion and oxidative-stress signature reflected by the other seven compounds. Together, the data describe a treatment-induced activation of the trans-sulfuration pathway producing elevated glutathione and phosphoserine, with pantothenic acid co-ordinately mobilized for CoA-dependent acetylation reactions and coumarin cleared via phase-I oxidative metabolism.

  "narrative_text": "Three complementary enrichment paradigms were applied to nine differentially abundant metabolites: RaMP multi-database ORA, Mummichog m/z-direct activity scoring, and MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA. RaMP ORA identified REACT:R-HSA-1430728 \"Metabolism\" (FDR 6.92e-05) as the top hit, with four input compounds contributing: pantothenic acid, coumarin, glutathione, and O-phospho-L-serine. Below this broad apex, the highest-scoring mechanistically interpretable pathway was WP:WP2525 \"Trans-sulfuration, one-carbon metabolism and related pathways\" (RaMP rank 3, FDR 3.58e-04, fold enrichment 450.3), driven by glutathione and O-phospho-L-serine. REACT:R-HSA-211859 \"Biological oxidations\" (RaMP rank 9, FDR 3.65e-03) captured coumarin and glutathione as overlapping members. Mummichog independently returned the same two cross-paradigm winners: MUMM:glycine_serine_alanine_and_threonine_metabolism (p=0.0046) and MUMM:xenobiotics_metabolism (p=0.0046), both with perfect 4-of-4 metabolite overlap. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA confirmed pantothenic acid (hsa00770, p=0.049) and glutathione (hsa00480, p=0.069) as single-compound hits, aligning with the pantothenic acid and glutathione arms seen in RaMP. react_result.final_narrative_text: Three complementary enrichment paradigms were applied to nine differentially abundant metabolites: RaMP multi-database ORA, Mummichog m/z-direct activity scoring, and MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA. RaMP ORA identified REACT:R-HSA-1430728 "Metabolism" (FDR 6.92e-05) as the top hit, with four input compounds contributing: pantothenic acid, coumarin, glutathione, and O-phospho-L-serine. Below this broad apex, the highest-scoring mechanistically interpretable pathway was WP:WP2525 "Trans-sulfuration, one-carbon metabolism and related pathways" (RaMP rank 3, FDR 3.58e-04, fold enrichment 450.3), driven by glutathione and O-phospho-L-serine. REACT:R-HSA-211859 "Biological oxidations" (RaMP rank 9, FDR 3.65e-03) captured coumarin and glutathione as overlapping members. Mummichog independently returned the same two cross-paradigm winners: MUMM:glycine_serine_alanine_and_threonine_metabolism (p=0.0046) and MUMM:xenobiotics_metabolism (p=0.0046), both with perfect 4-of-4 metabolite overlap. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA confirmed pantothenic acid (hsa00770, p=0.049) and glutathione (hsa00480, p=0.069) as single-compound hits, aligning with the pantothenic acid and glutathione arms seen in RaMP. Five input compounds — bromide, benzo[a]pyrene diol epoxide, methimazole, beta-mercaptoethanol, and N-hydroxy-4-aminobiphenyl — did not achieve individual pathway significance in any paradigm but may act as exogenous effect modifiers amplifying the glutathione and one-carbon stress signature. The convergent evidence across ORA and m/z-direct paradigms supports a treatment-induced perturbation of glutathione-dependent detoxification and the linked trans-sulfuration/one-carbon network.

RaMP ORA identified REACT:R-HSA-1430728 "Metabolism" (FDR 6.92e-05) as the top hit, with four input compounds contributing: pantothenic acid, coumarin, glutathione, and O-phospho-L-serine. Below this broad apex, the highest-scoring mechanistically interpretable pathway was WP:WP2525 "Trans-sulfuration, one-carbon metabolism and related pathways" (RaMP rank 3, FDR 3.58e-04, fold enrichment 450.3), driven by glutathione and O-phospho-L-serine. REACT:R-HSA-211859 "Biological oxidations" (RaMP rank 9, FDR 3.65e-03) captured coumarin and glutathione as overlapping members. Mummichog independently returned the same two cross-paradigm winners: MUMM:glycine_serine_alanine_and_threonine_metabolism (p=0.0046) and MUMM:xenobiotics_metabolism (p=0.0046), both with perfect 4-of-4 metabolite overlap. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA confirmed pantothenic acid (hsa00770, p=0.049) and glutathione (hsa00480, p=0.069) as single-compound hits, aligning with the pantothenic acid and glutathione arms seen in RaMP. Five input compounds — bromide, benzo[a]pyrene diol epoxide, methimazole, beta-mercaptoethanol, and N-hydroxy-4-aminobiphenyl — did not achieve individual pathway significance in any paradigm but may act as exogenous effect modifiers amplifying the glutathione and one-carbon stress signature. The convergent evidence across ORA and m/z-direct paradigms supports a treatment-induced perturbation of glutathione-dependent detoxification and the linked trans-sulfuration/one-carbon network.
